name: Catatan Maya
source:
You ignored her cries for help, and now it’s too late. Once, close friends, you abandoned Maya when she needed you the most. As she went missing, leaving only her middle finger, a ghostly figure resembling her terrorizes you and your classmates. Is it Maya, coming for revenge?

[From [url=https://memoriesinteractive.com/story/catatan-maya/]Memories Interactive[/url]]
